text:
Issue context: Text input value disappears when switching pages

Can you share a minimal code example that reproduces the problem?

Issue context: Text input value disappears when switching pages

Here is the example:
```python
import streamlit as st
st.text_input('Name', key='name')
```

Issue context: Text input value disappears when switching pages

Widget state is dropped when a widget is not rendered during a run. Copy the value into st.session_state under a different key before leaving the page, as described in the session state documentation.

Issue context: App stuck on loading spinner when deployed behind nginx

The page needs a WebSocket connection. Make sure your nginx config forwards the Upgrade and Connection headers for the Streamlit stream endpoint.

Issue context: Session state is empty after browser refresh

Session state lives in the browser session. A refresh starts a new session, so persist the login elsewhere, for example in a cookie or a database.

Issue context: App stuck on loading on my server but works locally

Same cause as the reverse proxy issue: check the WebSocket headers.

Session State (fixture)

Session State is a way to share variables between reruns, for each user session. Use st.session_state to store values such as a logged-in user. Widget state is deleted when the widget is no longer rendered during a run, for example when the user navigates to another page. To keep a widget value across pages, copy it into st.session_state under a different key. A new session starts when the app is opened in a new browser tab or the page is refreshed, so session state does not survive a browser refresh.

Deploy behind a reverse proxy (fixture)

Streamlit communicates with the browser over a WebSocket. When an app works locally but the page stays on the loading spinner on a server, the reverse proxy is usually not forwarding the WebSocket upgrade headers. Configure the proxy to pass the Upgrade and Connection headers, and check the stream endpoint. Reinstalling Streamlit does not change proxy behaviour.

Widget behavior (fixture)

A widget keeps its value between reruns only while it keeps being rendered with the same parameters and key. Changing the options or the key of a widget creates a new widget and its value resets. Use a stable key for widgets whose value should persist.
